name: Spider, Giant, Spitter
body:
Giant Spitter Spider
CR 2

XP 600
N Medium vermin
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+4 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 16 (3d8+3)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +1
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee bite +2 (1d6 plus poison)
Ranged poison spit +6 (poison)
Special Attacks web (+6 ranged, DC 12, hp 2)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 11, Dex 18, Con 12, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 1
Base Attack +2; CMB +2, CMD 16 (28 vs. trip)
Skills Climb +16, Perception +4 (+8 in webs), Stealth +8 (+12 in webs); Racial Modifiers +4 Perception (+8 in webs), +4 Stealth (+8 in webs), +16 Climb

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite or Spit-contact or injury; save Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Constitution and 1d2 Dexterity damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold forests and mountains, underground
Organization solitary, pair, or colony (3-8)
Treasure incidental

This otherwise hairy, large spider has hairless intimidating mandibles. Its’ mandibles drip with venom.

The spitter spider uses their ability to spit their debilitating poison to aid in their hunting when away from their webs. The cold climates they hail from mean that few creatures are to be found passing through their webs and the prey must be hunted and brought to the webs. Like all giant spiders, the giant spitter spider has a +2 racial bonus on poison save DCs.
